# Implement silver → gold aggregations & business transformations (`playbook-development-19`)

Agent generates a production-ready PySpark script to transform data from the Silver layer to the Gold layer following Medallion Architecture best practices. The script reads the source table, applies business transformations and aggregations using efficient PySpark DataFrame operations, and writes the final dataset to the target table in Delta format with overwrite mode.

It includes clear column aliases for aggregations, implements business logic using PySpark functions, and contains inline comments for readability and maintenance. The result is a scalable and analytics-ready Gold dataset optimized for BI reporting and downstream analytics.
